amendments.normalized_body: Reconcile the end-to-end instability regression introduced by the net-volume chemistry migration. Water is now seeded from substrate-displaced volume in `crates/tank_core/src/types/state.rs:52-61` and `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:471-479`, and the nitrogen cycle now consumes `state.water_volume_l()` / mg/L helpers in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:40-94`. With those changes, `cargo test --workspace --tests` is no longer green: `sad_rapid_water_changes_cause_instability` fails at `crates/tank_core/tests/end_to_end.rs:593`, only reaching about `0.09` instability after five 80% water changes instead of the required `> 0.1`. Either recalibrate the instability behavior under the new chemistry semantics or update the regression expectation with an explicit justification, but the branch should not merge while this scenario test is red.
